items.q: Mei has 3 bags with 5 sweets in each bag. Ali has 5 bags with 3 sweets in each bag. Who has more sweets?

slips.say: Work out Ali’s total too: 5 groups of 3.
Work out Mei’s total too: 3 groups of 5.

items.q: A bike has 2 wheels. How many wheels do 6 bikes have?
items.hint: Count in twos for each bike.

slips.say: 8 is 6 + 2. Each bike has 2 wheels: make 6 groups of 2.

tpl.q: A bike has 2 wheels. How many wheels do {n} bikes have?
tpl.hint: Count in twos for each bike.

items.q: Ali has 3 bags with 4 sweets in each bag and 2 more sweets. How many sweets does Ali have in all?
items.hint: First find the sweets in the bags. Then add the 2 more.

slips.say: 12 is the sweets in the bags. Add the 2 more sweets.

tpl.hint: First find the sweets in the bags. Then add the {c} more.

items.q: A bike has 2 wheels. A car has 4 wheels. How many wheels do 3 bikes and 4 cars have in all?
items.hint: Find the wheels on the bikes. Then find the wheels on the cars.

tpl.q: A bike has 2 wheels. A car has 4 wheels. How many wheels do {a} bikes and {b} cars have in all?
tpl.hint: Find the wheels on the bikes. Then find the wheels on the cars.

items.q: Jamie has 6 jars. Each jar has 5 marbles. He needs 40 marbles. How many more marbles does he need?
items.hint: Find the marbles in the jars now. Then see how many more make 40.

slips.say: 30 is the marbles in the jars. How many more make 40?

tpl.hint: Find the marbles in the jars now. Then see how many more make 40.

items.q: 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 = ___ × ___. Type exactly two numbers with a comma between them, like 3, 5.
items.hint: Count how many 4s there are. That is the number of groups.

items.q: Draw equal groups. Ask a grown-up to find the total. Check by counting in jumps. Many answers are right.
items.hint: Pick the number of groups and the number in each group first.
steps: Draw 3 or 4 plates with the same number on each.
